name: motionmaker
description: Make frame-exact motion graphics with Claude: one /motionmaker command with an art director that asks creative-brief questions, shows three directions, confirms a frame-locked brief, renders, reviews, adds synthesized sound and exports MP4/GIF. Includes reference-video analysis, a motion-technique catalog matcher, illustration and animation assets (Open Peeps, Humaaans, LottieFiles, Rive) with a licence ledger, optional libraries (bundled fonts per look, code reveals, equations, globe maps, hand-drawn marks, icon sets, frame-exact footage), fifteen templates and verification tools.
